reply: rms are very large and nearly cancel, so the sinusoidal form is probably a collinear approximation of something simpler. The rest of the candidate is roughly 0.55·P·ln P + 0.65·t, which suggests a Gompertz-like term, but my one attempt at a Gompertz form with a periodic carrying capacity fit poorly.

def equation(t, P, params):
    w = 0.07567597
    return (params[0] + params[1]*t + params[2]*np.sin(w*t) + params[3]*np.cos(w*t) + params[4]*np.sin(2*w*t) + params[5]*np.cos(2*w*t))/P + params[6]*P*np.log(P) + params[7] + params[8]*t + params[9]*P
